A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Will X EIGHT work with my phone?+

The concept range is designed for iOS 16 or later and Android 10 or later. Pair through the X EIGHT companion app. This store is a demo; no hardware or companion app is being sold here.

Which X EIGHT is right for me?+

Choose X Ultra for outdoor performance, titanium and 72-hour battery life. X Pro balances advanced fitness and everyday use. X Core keeps your daily essentials simple. Use our comparison tool to see all specifications side by side.

Can I change the strap?+

Yes. Explore graphite, natural titanium and expedition orange in our interactive 3D configurator. Each watch includes your selected silicone strap in S/M or M/L.

How does demo checkout work?+

Choose a watch, add it to your bag and complete the sample delivery form. You’ll receive a demo order confirmation on screen. No money is collected, no order is sent, and delivery details are not stored.
